 Here are the Cricket Predictions for the Women's Big Bash League 2026 - 9th Match - Hobart Hurricanes Women vs Melbourne Renegades Women, to be played on the 4th of November at the Bellerive Oval, Hobart.
 Match Prediction - Hobart Hurricanes Women v Melbourne Renegades Women 
 9th Match - Hobart Hurricanes Women vs Melbourne Renegades Women (Bellerive Oval, Hobart) 
 Ground Stat:
 Average 1st Innings Total at Bellerive Oval, Hobart (Women's Big Bash League) - 144 
 Average 2nd Innings Total at Bellerive Oval, Hobart (Women's Big Bash League) - 132 
 Batting Stats WOMENT20 
 Current Form Hobart Hurricanes Women:
 Hobart Hurricanes Women are currently placed at the bottom most position on points table with 2 losses to their credit. They have 0 point to their name. Their NRR is -2.625. 
 The top run scorer for Hobart Hurricanes Women in the Women's Big Bash League 2026 is Lizelle Lee with 57 runs to her name. 
 The top wicket taker for Hobart Hurricanes Women in the Women's Big Bash League 2026 is Heather Graham with 2 scalps under her belt. 
 Hobart Hurricanes Women have lost their previous match against Sydney Sixers Women by a big margin of 87 runs.
 Sydney Sixers Women batted first and they posted a huge total of 196 for 8 in 20 overs. They lost their way right from the word go and were reduced to 6 for 3 in the 3rd over itself. After that phase, Ashleigh Gardner and Alice Capsey revived the innings. They added 176 runs for the 4th wicket partnership. Capsey made 54 off 40 balls while Ashleigh Gardner scored 124 runs in only 60 balls, collecting 10 fours and 9 sixes. On the back of such brilliant batting performances, Sydney Sixers Women managed to reach 196 in 20 overs of play.
 During the chase, Hobart Hurricanes Women got off to the most terrible start, losing 5 wickets for just 26 runs. Maddy Green and Chinelle Henry tried their best to revive the innings but they also threw it away when it mattered the most. Wickets kept falling in regular succession and Hobart Hurricanes Women got bowled out for 109, losing the match by 87 runs. For Sydney Sixers Women, Ashleigh Gardner and Amelia Kerr were the stars of the show. Both of them picked up 3 wickets each.
 Current Form Melbourne Renegades Women:
 Melbourne Renegades Women are currently placed at the 7th position on points table with 2 losses to their credit. They have 0 point to their name. Their NRR is -2.265. 
 The top run scorer for Melbourne Renegades Women in the Women's Big Bash League 2026 is Georgia Wareham with 85 runs to her name. 
 The top wicket taker for Melbourne Renegades Women in the Women's Big Bash League 2026 is Tayla Vlaeminck with 3 scalps under her belt. 
 Melbourne Renegades Women have lost their previous match against Perth Scorchers Women by 9 wickets.
 Melbourne Renegades Women batted first and they posted a total of 136 for 6 in 20 overs. Hayley Matthews, Courtney Webb, Sophie Molineux and Tess Flintoff all got out without troubling the scorers much and Melbourne Renegades Women looked in all sorts of bother. Nicole Faltum and Georgia Wareham played well. Faltum made 48 runs while Wareham scored 62 runs in 39 deliveries to help Melbourne Renegades Women get to 136 in 20 overs of play.
 During the chase, Katie Mack got out without troubling the scorers much. Beth Mooney and Sophie Devine then took the responsibility of taking Perth Scorchers Women over the line. Mooney made 58 off 40 balls while Devine scored 47 runs in 32 deliveries. Both stayed not out and helped Perth Scorchers Women get over the line in the 14th over itself with 9 wickets in hand.
